source_categories.description: National or subnational public health agencies and CDC-like organizations.
International health organizations and regional surveillance reports.
Peer-reviewed studies containing human outbreak, case series, or surveillance data.
Structured outbreak, surveillance, or epidemiological databases.
Reputable news reports, situation reports, or alerts that may contain early outbreak signals.

include_if_all_apply: The source is about hantavirus disease, HPS, HFRS, or a named hantavirus.
The source concerns human cases, human outbreaks, or human surveillance summaries.
The source contains or is likely to contain at least one target data field: cases, deaths, date, location, source URL, source type, or evidence text.
exclude_if_any_apply: The source is only about animal or rodent surveillance and does not report human cases.
The source is only a general prevention or clinical overview page without case counts or outbreak information.
The source is an animal-only laboratory experiment.
The source is unrelated to hantavirus.
The source is a duplicate of an already registered source.
uncertain_if_any_apply: The source mentions hantavirus but the snippet does not show whether human case data are included.
The source appears to discuss background or historical outbreaks but may contain extractable records.
The source may mix animal surveillance with human cases.
